title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ToM2Vec，用固定预算的连续 token 在隐空间形成伙伴心理状态表征，并以伙伴真实想法监督这些 token，测试时作为智能体推理与行动的条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉任务，但其隐式 token 对多假设伙伴状态的抽象、latent 与文本推理的对照及外部模型泛化，可供核查 LVR 中状态表示容量、监督信号和视觉信息保留问题。

title: Loopholing All the Way: Language Modeling with pure Self-Conditioning
summary: Recent Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) use Self-Conditioning (SC), or Loopholing, to improve their performance. While SC is traditionally seen as an auxiliary heuristic, its empirical success raises the question: can a continuous generative model be based purely on Self-Conditioning? We answer affirmatively with LAW (``Loopholing All the Way''), which propagates the Expected Embedding under the denoiser's prediction across steps, decoding the tokens once, at the end. On Sudoku, LAW outperforms previous Discrete and Continuous Diffusion Models, including Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. On Maze, LAW is the most accurate from 2 to 64 NFE. After training on TinyGSM and sampling at temperature 1 with 1024 NFE, LAW solves 42.2% of GSM8K problems against 34.5% for uniform Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. Additionally, fine-tuning a pre-trained Uniform Diffusion Model (Duo) with LAW increases its accuracy from 17.2% to 48.1%. Finally, on OpenWebText, LAW pushes the Pareto frontier and approaches Autoregressive Models (ARMs) with 64 NFE. Find our code at https://github.com/ilievanadezhda/law.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LAW，把扩散语言模型中的 Self-Conditioning（Loopholing）由辅助启发式升级为纯生成机制：在去噪器预测下跨步传播期望 embedding，仅在最后一次性解码 token，并在 Sudoku、Maze、TinyGSM/GSM8K 与 OpenWebText 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其连续状态跨步传播、末端单次解码以及 NFE 与精度的权衡，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新方式与解码时机；但该工作为纯文本扩散，缺少视觉多模态验证，迁移性仍是推测。

title: Complexity-Aware Surgical Video Reasoning Segmentation with Digital Twin and Context Memory
summary: Conventional surgical segmentation relies on closed-set categories or explicit text queries, which cannot resolve implicit queries that require reasoning about workflows, instrument functions, and temporal relationships. To address these limitations, we propose SurgReasonSeg, a complexity-aware method that brings reasoning segmentation over digital twin (DT) representations to surgical video. Specifically, SurgReasonSeg constructs DT representations from surgical foundation models and trains two low-rank adapters (LoRA) of one large language model with reinforcement learning (RL), each specialized for a different query complexity. A lightweight router, also trained with RL, selects between the two adapters to balance latency against accuracy. SurgReasonSeg also sets the temporal context with an adaptive sliding window conditioned on query complexity and workflow phase, and retrieves relevant historical cases from a surgical context memory by workflow similarity and procedural relevance. We further introduce EndoVis-ReasonSeg, a surgical reasoning segmentation benchmark with 1,460 training and 961 test samples across semantic, spatial, and temporal categories. On EndoVis-ReasonSeg, SurgReasonSeg improves J&F over the strongest baseline, ReSurgSAM2, by 0.178, 0.237, and 0.297 on semantic, spatial, and temporal queries, and it also achieves the best results on the Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 referring segmentation benchmarks. A backbone-matched attribution protocol separates the contribution of the upstream segmenter from that of the reasoning modules. Our method runs at 18.8 FPS averaged over the query distribution, enabling real-time reasoning segmentation in surgical videos.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SurgReasonSeg，在手术视频上用手术基础模型构建数字孪生表示，以强化学习训练两个按查询复杂度区分的 LoRA 适配器和一个路由器，并结合自适应时序窗口与按流程相似度检索的历史案例记忆，同时发布 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 推理分割基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 复杂度感知路由、自适应窗口与上下文记忆涉及「何时扩展视觉证据、如何分配计算」的问题，可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本收益与证据筛选；但核心仍是分割与数字孪生表示，未涉及推理期 latent 状态，联系较间接。

title: A Unified Evaluation Framework of Physical Adversarial Robustness in the Edge VLM Era
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD). 16 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable end-to-end visual grounding via language prompts and generative decoding, demonstrating largely improved zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection capabilities. As a result, VLMs are rapidly being deployed at the edge in safety-critical real-world systems. However, the physical adversarial robustness of edge VLMs has not been systematically studied, and the fundamental differences in output with modern object detectors create methodological challenges for fair evaluation. To compare the two families directly, we evaluate every selected representative model on one outcome: whether an adversarial patch worn on a person evades detection of the model. We report this by introducing a unified metric, conditional attack success rate (cASR), counted only on images the model still localizes under a matched gray occluder, and partition every failure into omission (no box), substitution (a box on the patch), and displacement (a box on neither). We benchmark the physical adversarial vulnerability of compact grounding VLMs against a range of object detectors, and find that the VLMs can be as vulnerable as the detectors. We disclose that failure mode is largely associated with the output format of a model rather than its architecture family. Of the three, only omission is visible to a downstream system; displacement and substitution return confident, well-formed boxes, making them potentially more dangerous failures. Further, we find that, under distribution shift, VLMs that primarily failed by omission instead shift to failing more by displacement/substitution. Thus, a grounding VLM can inherit the detector's vulnerability while showing the possibility to adopt more dangerous failure modes. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建统一的物理对抗鲁棒性评测框架，在人物佩戴对抗补丁的场景下用条件攻击成功率（cASR）直接比较紧凑型 grounding VLM 与目标检测器，并把失败细分为 omission、substitution、displacement 三类，发现失败模式更多取决于输出格式而非架构族，且分布偏移下 VLM 会从 omission 转向更隐蔽的 substitution/displacement。
AI.relevance_reason: 其失败分类可用于核查 VLM 是否真正依赖目标视觉证据：substitution 即在补丁处给出高置信框，类似视觉旁路或被对抗证据劫持，可作为视觉证据筛选与失败诊断的参考，但未涉及 latent 推理状态本身，需较多核查。

title: OACap: Caption-Guided Active Observation for Detailed Video Captioning
summary: Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OACap，一个以 caption 为中心的视频 agent：把缺失或缺乏支撑的信息转成针对性观察请求，用时空工具取证并迭代验证修订描述；同时构建 FSCap-Bench，以主张精确度加重要性加权事实覆盖（CSFS）和跨模态语义往返（CSRS）诊断描述保留的信息。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「决定获取何种证据—取证—验证并停止」的观察循环与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本和视觉证据筛选直接相关，FSCap-Bench 对信息保留的诊断也可供核查「信息坍缩」类问题；但状态为显式 caption 而非 latent，向 LVR 的迁移需阅读原文确认。

title: Look Beyond the Question: Preserve-Focus-Fuse for Whole-Slide Image Question Answering
summary: A question about a whole-slide image rarely names every morphological finding needed to answer it. Question-guided patch selection can therefore overlook supporting morphology, while slide-level compression can dilute focal evidence. Inspired by how pathologists combine broad slide review, question-directed examination, and integration of their findings, we introduce BEYONDPATH, a Preserve-Focus-Fuse framework for whole-slide image question answering. Preserve learns a question-agnostic Morphology Bank through answer supervision across multiple questions about each training slide. Focus retrieves questionspecific evidence from all foreground patches, including regions outside the Bank. Fuse integrates the preserved morphology at the retrieved evidence positions through Morphology-on-Visual-Evidence Fusion, producing a fixed 96-token visual prefix. On WSI-Bench, BEYONDPATH achieves an Avg-9 of 0.769 and leads all eight reported report-generation metrics using the same checkpoint. It also achieves 0.639 zero-shot overall accuracy on SlideBench-BCNB. Controlled ablations show complementary benefits from morphology preservation and question-directed retrieval, and support cross-question supervision and fusion at the evidence positions. These results support looking beyond the question's explicit cues: preserving broader slide morphology while retaining the ability to seek evidence for each question.

AI.brief_summary: 面向全切片图像问答提出 BEYONDPATH 的「保留-聚焦-融合」框架：先用答案监督在每张训练切片的多问题上学出与问题无关的形态库，再从全部前景 patch 检索问题相关证据，并在证据位置融合形态信息，输出固定 96 token 的视觉前缀，在 WSI-Bench 与 SlideBench-BCNB 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文直接处理「问题引导筛选会漏掉支撑性形态」「切片级压缩稀释焦点证据」，与视觉证据筛选和压缩致信息坍缩的关切贴近；其与问题无关的形态库、证据位置融合及固定 token 前缀可供核查证据保留与视觉旁路之间的取舍，但属病理专用流程，未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与更新。

title: S^3martCirc: Self-supervised Smart Circuit Discovery
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse tasks, from text summarization to question answering. Despite these capabilities, their black-box nature obscures internal decision-making processes. Mechanistic interpretability (MI) aims to address this by reverse-engineering neural networks into human-understandable algorithms. Current MI approaches for LLMs typically follow a two-stage paradigm: first identifying important components (circuit discovery), where components are typically individual nodes such as an attention head or feedforward neuron, and second determining the role they play in a certain task (functional interpretation). However, this sequential approach overlooks a fundamental insight: a component's importance and its functional role are inherently codependent. Unifying these stages presents two key challenges: (1) functional roles are often tied to specific nodes or components, limiting generalization, and (2) their identification relies on subjective interpretation rather than quantifiable metrics. To address these challenges, we propose S^3martCirc (Self-supervised Smart Circuit Discovery), a unified framework that simultaneously discovers circuits and interprets functionality. S^3martCirc abstracts node behavior into two general computational roles that generalize across tasks and defines a quantitative metric for assigning them, enabling importance and functional role to be discovered jointly rather than in sequence. Extensive experiments show that our framework outperforms existing methods in circuit discovery.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 S^3martCirc 框架，把节点的行为抽象为两类可跨任务泛化的计算角色，并给出量化指标，使「电路发现」与「功能解释」不再是先后两个阶段，而是在 LLM 中联合完成；实验显示其在电路发现上优于现有方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本的机制可解释性工作，但其「重要性依赖功能角色」的联合度量可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据贡献分配与 latent 状态承载位置的问题，尚需确认该指标能否迁移到多模态节点。

title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
summary: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.

AI.brief_summary: 针对分离式 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存未命中既需重算又需跨节点传输的问题，提出 KVLearn：用轻量前缀复用预测器估计复用概率，再折算重算、传输与存储成本形成保留/准入评分，并用在线阈值控制器调节准入策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「学习预测复用概率＋成本加权保留决策＋在线阈值」可作核查线索，可能迁移到 latent 状态与视觉证据的缓存取舍及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本核算，但原论文关注服务层 KV 缓存，与推理期内部状态的关系尚未验证。

title: SpecEvo: Speculative Evolution with Large Language Models for Cost-Efficient Scientific Discovery
summary: LLM-driven evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for scientific discovery, but existing methods remain costly and slow, often applying expensive reasoning uniformly while underusing evidence from failed, redundant, and saturated trials. We introduce Speculative Evolution (SpecEvo), a multi-LLM framework that coordinates lightweight and frontier models through continual consolidation of search evidence. Lightweight models power both parallel Speculators, which generate and refine candidate programs, and an Advisor, which distills accumulated successes, failures, and saturated directions into persistent guidance for subsequent exploration. At sparse checkpoints, a frontier-model Navigator inspects the evolving population and intervenes through synthesis, surgical refinement, or reframing according to search stagnation. This speculate-then-consolidate workflow delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to inexpensive models while reserving frontier reasoning for strategic interventions whose benefits extend across many subsequent low-cost evaluations. Across 176 tasks spanning four scientific and algorithmic discovery domains, SpecEvo matches or outperforms frontier-model baselines while reducing API cost by up to 80%, achieves up to 1.5x greater evaluation efficiency than cost-efficient baselines on equation discovery, and improves over the strongest CO-Bench baseline by 3.8%. These results support trajectory-conditioned model coordination as an effective approach to cost-efficient scientific discovery.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SpecEvo 多 LLM 框架：轻量模型并行生成与改写候选程序，并由 Advisor 持续整合成功、失败与饱和方向的证据；前沿模型仅在稀疏检查点以 Navigator 身份按停滞情况做综合、精修或重设框架，在 176 个科学发现任务上以更低 API 成本匹配或超过前沿基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「停滞信号触发稀疏高成本推理」与对失败、冗余试验证据的持续蒸馏，可能为 LVR 的动态计算分配与停止决策提供可核查线索；与视觉或多模态内部表示无直接关系，迁移需较多判断。

title: Offline Apprenticeship Learning for Human-Centric Environments
summary: Effective decision-making in human-centric environments such as Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs) and clinical healthcare requires policies that are adaptive, data-efficient, and ethically deployable. Apprenticeship Learning (AL) infers policies directly from expert demonstrations by recovering the underlying reward structure, enabling strictly offline learning without environment interaction. This dissertation develops a progression of offline AL frameworks organized around two challenges: reward modeling and demonstration quality. For reward modeling, EM-EDM clusters demonstrations by latent reward functions and induces cluster-specific policies, and THEMES partitions trajectories into temporally coherent sub-trajectories guided by a hierarchically learned reward regulator; across one educational and three clinical datasets, THEMES outperforms flat and hierarchical AL baselines. For demonstration quality, HALIDE integrates continuous quality signals into hierarchical policy induction, enabling principled reuse of mixed-quality data under distribution shift. CCHAL further attributes quality to individual decisions via Bayesian credit assignment, dual-arm criticality scoring that contrasts expert and non-expert behavior, and a Bradley-Terry contrastive IRL objective over failure trajectories, outperforming baselines including HALIDE on three clinical EHR datasets and an ITS dataset. Finally, a real-world classroom evaluation of StuEDM, an EDM-induced policy that preserves student agency and intervenes only on disagreement, shows significant learning gains over an Expert baseline and a higher pretest-adjusted posttest score than a CQL policy trained on a far larger corpus, while overriding students less than half as often. Together, this work establishes offline AL as a practical, data-efficient, and ethically viable paradigm for human-centric environments.

AI.brief_summary: 该博士论文围绕离线 apprenticeship learning 展开，从奖励建模与示范质量两条线提出 EM-EDM、THEMES、HALIDE、CCHAL 等框架，并在教育、临床数据及真实课堂中评估所学策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽不涉及视觉或多模态，但其时序子轨迹切分、决策级 Bayesian 信用分配与混合质量示范加权，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的步骤贡献分配与监督筛选提供可核查的方法线索。

title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
summary: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4B and eight mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, ReAPO improves first-attempt performance over GRPO as well as natural recent baseline algorithms, while additional ablations demonstrate the utility of both serial sampling and ReAPO's credit assignment. On Qwen3-0.6B, ReAPO also outperforms GRPO with twice the group size or twice the training steps, reaching their peak accuracy with 39% and 31% fewer generated tokens, respectively. Taken together, our results suggest that ReAPO is a simple yet effective approach for improving LM reasoning performance through improved exploration and retry-aware credit assignment.

AI.brief_summary: 该文将带重试的探索式推理采样建模为随机最短路问题，据此提出 ReAPO：在 GRPO 基础上对失败轨迹追加生成、只强化成功重试而不奖励先前失败，从而为多次尝试分配更合理的信用；在 Qwen3 与 OLMo-2（0.6B–4B）及八个数学与科学推理基准上验证首答准确率与生成成本优势。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 RLVR 工作，但其「串行尝试间的信用分配」思路可能为 LVR 中多步 latent 状态或多次采样的贡献分配与轨迹监督提供可核查线索，需进一步确认能否迁移到 latent 步骤而非仅按尝试划分。

title: Motion Equivariant Convolutional LSTM: When Motion Becomes a Gauge Symmetry
summary: Objects move, cameras pan, and weather drifts with the wind: much of what changes in sequential data is motion. Motion changes where things are, not what they are, and is therefore a symmetry of the data. Yet standard recurrent networks are not equivariant to it: their memory stays put while the input moves on. Flow equivariant recurrent networks first brought this symmetry into sequence models, for motions of constant velocity, or flows, by enumerating a bank of velocities. We extend this idea in three directions: from simple recurrent networks to convolutional LSTMs, from flows to motions whose velocity changes in time, and from enumerating velocities to estimating them. Treating a sequence as a field over time, we show that motion becomes a gauge symmetry: a global symmetry made local in time. Built on this view, our motion equivariant convolutional LSTM (MELSTM) uses its velocity model as the gauge field and is provably equivariant to every motion. Across future-frame prediction, classification of digits visible only through their motion, and action recognition under camera shake, MELSTM outperforms a convolutional LSTM and its flow equivariant counterpart with the same number of parameters: it is more accurate, generalizes to longer horizons and to unseen motions, and carries a fraction of the flow equivariant model's state.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把序列中的运动视为规范对称性，将流等变循环网络扩展到卷积 LSTM，用时变速度估计模型充当规范场，使记忆对任意运动可证明等变，并在未来帧预测、仅凭运动可辨的数字分类和镜头抖动下的动作识别中验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「记忆随输入运动等变更新、速度作为隐状态」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态在视觉变换下保持内容一致、按证据移动而更新提供具体结构线索，是否适用于推理状态可供核查。

title: Measure First, Then Allocate: Calibrated Rollout Budgets for MCP Agents in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Training tool-using language models requires costly interaction, yet identical rewards within a rollout group provide no group-relative learning signal. We use reward disagreement to guide harness evaluation and the allocation of rollouts for policy training in Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments. We first introduce Discord, which tests harness edits using exact paired inference and decision-preserving early stopping: only disagreeing paired outcomes favor one harness over another. This insight motivates prospective allocation in BRACE (Bank-calibrated Rollout Allocation under Correlated Episodes). BRACE combines historical task evidence, uncertainty in task success rates, and a correlated reward model to forecast mixed-reward groups before allocating generation budget. Controlled harness experiments favor Discord, while live MCP experiments expose a retention-cost trade-off. At three Qwen3-VL model scales, BRACE exceeds the strongest plotted baseline peaks with fewer new training rollouts; historical-bank collection is counted separately. It also leads the compared methods on BFCL and NESTFUL without further training. Ablations probe the bank, estimator, and allocation score; prospective evaluation checks forecast calibration. These results support forecasting reward contrast before generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Discord 与 BRACE，利用配对推理下的奖励分歧评估 harness，并在生成前预测混合奖励组以分配 MCP 智能体的 rollout 训练预算。
AI.relevance_reason: 其奖励分歧预测与决策保持早停可能为 LVR 的动态计算、停止决策及训练预算分配提供线索，但未研究 latent 视觉推理状态，迁移价值需核查。

title: ArcFlow: Training Flow Policies for Multiple Solver Budgets
summary: Flow-matching policies adjust inference cost through the number of solver steps, but reinforcement learning at a single fixed solver budget can hide degradation at cheaper deployment budgets and even erase useful one-step behavior present in a pretrained policy. We introduce Action-Ratio-Clip Flow (ArcFlow), a deployment-aware algorithm for training one flow policy across a specified range of solver budgets. ArcFlow combines action-aligned supervision, budget exposure, and worst-budget checkpoint selection. For reconstruction objectives, its bridge aggregates temporal probes into one surrogate ratio and one PPO-style clip per action, with a boundary residual exactly equal to deployed one-step reconstruction error. Cycling exposes the shared field to the deployment range, and selection optimizes its performance floor. For native velocity objectives, multi-budget endpoint supervision applies the same principle without replacing the native update. Both realizations preserve the architecture and deployment-time cost. Across DM Control, manipulation, and locomotion, ArcFlow attains the highest mean one-step return among five flow-policy baselines on 25 of 30 tasks under each method's reported training settings. Component studies identify complementary improvements from boundary supervision, the fixed-grid bridge, budget exposure, and deployment selection. These results establish deployment-budget-aware training as an effective route to strong low-step control with one policy serving multiple inference costs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ArcFlow，在指定的多个 solver 步数预算下训练单一 flow-matching 控制策略，结合动作对齐监督、预算暴露与最差预算 checkpoint 选择，在 DM Control、操作与运动任务上提升低步数下的回报。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向机器人动作生成而非视觉推理，但其「同一生成场覆盖多档采样步数预算、以性能下限做选择」的训练思路，可能可供核查于 latent 生成式推理由多步到少步时的质量保持与预算感知训练。

title: An Explicit Feedback Contract for Iterative ML-Agent Harnesses
summary: Iterative ML agents develop models by editing code, running experiments, reading a validation score, and choosing what to try next. In current harnesses this loop is served by an exact validation score returned after every attempt, which leaves the validation split open to adaptive selection. In this work, we introduce an explicit feedback contract for ML-agent harnesses, which specifies what an agent may observe, when iteration should stop, and when the test split may be touched. The contract releases a validation score only when a submission clears a noise threshold computed from the paired standard error, so no margin has to be tuned. We ran experiments on click-through-rate prediction, learning to rank, and a control task with no signal to find. The control is the sharpest case, because the true gain there is zero by construction: an agent reading exact scores ended by reporting a gain of 0.0157, while under the contract it reported 0.0033. On both real tasks the contract narrows the validation-test gap, and test performance is slightly higher rather than lower. The largest difference is in when the agents stop. Exact feedback used its entire budget of thirty submissions on two of the three tasks, including the one where nothing can be learned, while the contract halted after four to twelve. A run that exhausts its budget is usually read as diligence. It is better read as a symptom: when the feedback channel is unbounded, noise keeps supplying improvements to chase.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为迭代式 ML agent 提出「显式反馈契约」，规定 agent 能观察到什么、何时停止迭代、何时可触碰测试集，并在验证分数达到由配对标准误算出的噪声阈值时才释放；在 CTR 预测、learning to rank 和一个无信号对照任务上检验了停止时机与验证—测试差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中基于噪声阈值的反馈释放与「无限反馈通道会持续追逐噪声」的停止分析，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止决策与噪声证据筛选提供借鉴线索，但需核查其从 ML-agent 实验循环迁移到多模态 latent 推理的可行性。

title: SAIL: A Learnable Generalisation of Spatial Autocorrelation over Graph-Structured Data
comment: 44 pages, 22 figures (7 in main paper, 15 in supplementary material). Main paper followed by supplementary material in a single file
summary: In vision and scientific domains involving spatial data, a key question is whether node feature values vary independently across space or form coherent spatial structures. Classical spatial autocorrelation statistics such as Moran's $I$ and Geary's $C$ quantify this phenomenon but operate on a single scalar variable with fixed neighbourhood weights, limiting their use for high-dimensional graph-like data. We introduce SAIL (Spatial Autocorrelation Index Learner), a differentiable framework that generalises spatial autocorrelation into a learnable operator by jointly learning feature projections defining candidate scalar fields and inter-node neighbourhood affinities. SAIL produces interpretable local and global spatial coherence descriptors, enabling supervised prediction and unsupervised discovery of spatial autocorrelation modes and hotspots. We show that SAIL exactly recovers classical spatial statistics under appropriate parametrisations and, for tasks driven by latent spatial autocorrelation, can approximate the Bayes-optimal predictor with an inductive bias matched to such tasks. Experiments on synthetic data and large-scale biomedical graphs demonstrate statistical correctness and discovery of spatial coherence with applications across vision, geospatial analysis, and biomedicine. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/pkeller00/SAIL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SAIL，一个可微框架，通过联合学习特征投影与节点间邻域亲和度，把 Moran's I、Geary's C 类空间自相关统计推广为可学习的局部与全局空间连贯性描述子，用于有监督预测与无监督模式发现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可微、可学习的空间自相关算子或可供核查能否作为探测 latent 视觉状态中空间连贯性/空间结构保留程度的诊断或辅助目标，但论文面向图上的空间统计，与 VLM 推理的联系需自行验证。

title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing
summary: Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. Empirically, across three distinct benchmarks, SSR achieves state-of-the-art results in all six configurations. Notably, as the task pool grows from 40 to 200, SSR steadily improves the pass rate from 64.3% to 68.3%, while the baselines' performances all drop. Furthermore, its racing mechanism identifies near-optimal candidates while reducing validation executions by 60%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发现 agent harness 进化中任务池扩大会因证据选择不佳反而降低性能，提出 SSR 按任务质量与覆盖度构造多样证据组合，并在小算力预算下竞速候选 harness。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据组合筛选＋小预算竞速候选」可能为 LVR 中多个 latent 假设或推理轨迹的预算受限筛选、验证与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索，但此处证据是优化任务而非视觉证据，迁移需谨慎。

title: HorizonComposer: Spatiotemporally Consistent Driving Video Editing with Enriched Traffic Semantics
summary: Instruction-guided video generative models offer a scalable solution for stress-testing autonomous driving systems by simulating diverse environmental conditions. However, driving scenes operate within a dense Operational Design Domain (ODD) governed by strict traffic semantics. When applied to global driving-condition edits, general-purpose instruction-guided video editors frequently corrupt these semantics, leading to structural hallucinations and ``temporal shock.'' This work distills and protects traffic semantics during video editing at three levels. First, we construct a hybrid dataset by combining temporally aligned real-world videos with synthetic edits, balancing foundational scene structure with unambiguous appearance signals. Second, during training, we adapt advantage conditioning from offline reinforcement learning to align the model using dense rewards. We extract dense, pixel-level rewards from the hybrid data to serve as a localized signal and actively steer generation toward structurally reliable pixels. Finally, our model mitigates temporal shock by introducing thinking frames, a transition mechanism that seamlessly reconciles static image conditioning with dynamic video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method prevents the corruption of multi-actor dynamics, establishing state-of-the-art spatiotemporal consistency, yielding consistent user preference (39% relative improvement in content preservation and 12% in temporal consistency), and achieving a significant 5% gain in downstream road line segmentation and 7% gain in downstream multi-object detection.

AI.brief_summary: 构建真实视频与合成编辑混合的驾驶视频编辑数据，将离线 RL 的 advantage conditioning 结合像素级稠密奖励用于训练，并用「thinking frames」过渡机制缓解静态图像条件与动态视频上下文之间的时间突变。
AI.relevance_reason: 以稠密像素级奖励作局部信号主动引导生成，可能与 LVR 中 latent 内容的细粒度贡献分配与监督可供核查；但任务是驾驶视频编辑，「thinking frames」并非推理期 latent 状态，与视觉推理主线联系较弱。

title: Speedrunning Relational Foundation Model Pretraining
authors: Gabriel Wedson Mendonça de Souza Veloso
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the CODEC-FM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Progress on foundation model pretraining is gated by who can afford a trial, and relational pretraining is no exception. Recipes are developed inside individual labs, reported under private protocols, and do not accumulate. Speedrun leaderboards remove that barrier by decentralizing the search rather than the training run. The problem is fixed, the stack is open, entries are ranked by wall-clock time to a quality target, and one GPU is enough to hold the record. We introduce modded-nanoRT, the first such leaderboard for Relational Transformers. Which database to hold out decides whether the benchmark can resolve improvements at all, so we fix it by calibration, ranking six candidates by how sharply a 45-minute learning curve separates improvement from seed noise. We open the leaderboard with typed trilinear attention, a relational operator that conditions attention scores and values on the foreign key traversed, together with Muon and SIGReg. The recipe reaches the target in 305.63 seconds on one NVIDIA H200, 8.11x faster than the reference implementation, and wins 13 of 15 pairs outside the development database. We will release the benchmark, its frozen artifacts, and the record runs. Our code is available at https://github.com/kunumi/nanoRT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出首个 Relational Transformer 预训练「速通」排行榜 modded-nanoRT，先经校准选定留出数据库，再以 typed trilinear attention、Muon 与 SIGReg 的组合在单张 H200 上 305.63 秒达到质量目标，比参考实现快 8.11 倍。
AI.relevance_reason: typed trilinear attention 将遍历到的外键关系类型注入注意力分数与 value，可供核查其是否能作为多模态 latent 状态中保留实体关系的设计线索；但论文核心是预训练效率基准与协议，与 LVR 推理期状态使用相距较远。

title: Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation for Few-shot Image Classification
comment: This work is accepted by The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Few-shot image classification (FSIC) frequently suffers from visual ambiguity, where background clutter and RGB appearance similarities hinder discriminative feature matching in data-scarce settings. To mitigate this, we propose DAFIC, a geometry-guided framework that incorporates monocular depth into representation learning, episodic adaptation, and dense support-query matching. DAFIC first learns geometry-aware token representations through RGB-D self-supervised pre-training. Subsequently, the Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation (DGA) module uses depth-derived geometry to refine patch representations with geometry-enriched class context while suppressing background interference. Spatial Bidirectional Patch Matching (SBiM) then performs bidirectional dense matching on the refined features, reducing sensitivity to spurious correspondences and background clutter. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks show that DAFIC achieves strong performance against existing methods, with ablation and robustness analyses supporting the effectiveness of coupling geometry-conditioned episodic adaptation with bidirectional matching for few-shot visual recognition.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DAFIC 框架，将单目深度引入 RGB-D 自监督预训练、depth-guided 的 episodic 几何适配与双向稠密 patch 匹配，以缓解 few-shot 分类中背景杂乱和 RGB 外观相似造成的视觉歧义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其深度引导的 patch 级几何细化与背景抑制、双向匹配，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与几何信息保留提供可核查的方法线索，但原文不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或动态计算。

title: RL-IF: Tracking Non-local Training Data Influence for Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. We then derive RL-IF, a first-order estimator that propagates data influence through both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects, and provide theoretical guarantees on its approximation accuracy under smoothness assumptions. Our analysis further disentangles these two effects and shows both theoretically and empirically that the full RL-IF estimator can often be well approximated using the optimization effect alone. Building on this observation, we develop RINSE, a practical data filtering method for online RL. Experiments on standard control benchmarks and an RLHF-style toxicity-mitigation setting show that RINSE improves training efficiency and final performance over standard PPO and local attribution baselines. These results suggest that RL-IF provides a practical and principled framework for understanding and improving online RL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出轨迹级留一法量 RL-LOO，并推导一阶影响函数估计器 RL-IF，用以追踪在线 RL 中训练样本经优化和策略采样对后续目标的非局部影响，进而实现数据过滤方法 RINSE。
AI.relevance_reason: 其非局部影响传播与优化/采样效应的拆分可供核查，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选提供线索，但论文本身未涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态。

title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
summary: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural reuse. In continual domain adaptation settings, SST consistently reduces forgetting while improving generalization to related tasks. Across two 3B instruction-tuned backbones, SST improves average final performance on streamed domains by 2.53 to 5.75 points over sequential post-training. It also lowers max-drop forgetting in all evaluated settings, with the largest reduction from 42.41 to 7.10 points on the Qwen-3B MATH stream, while substantially recovering the OOD degradation induced by sequential updates.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对后训练中持续域适应的灾难性遗忘，提出 Skill Schema Transport：把新领域样例抽象为剥离领域表层形式、保留关键操作与验证步骤的技能模式，使知识更新从轨迹记忆转为可复用程序，在两个 3B 模型上减少遗忘并改善迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本域适应工作，但「将样例重铸为可复用技能模式与验证步骤」可能为 LVR 的轨迹式训练、贡献分配与监督结构提供可核查的方法线索。

title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
summary: Frontier language-model agents excel at complex tasks, but high inference costs make transferring their capabilities to smaller models essential. Traditional knowledge distillation achieves this through parameter updates, requiring access to the student's weights and additional training compute while encoding the transferred knowledge implicitly in the parameters. We introduce D-Skill, a framework that treats the teacher as a black box and distills its behavioral advantage into an interpretable natural-language skill by analyzing paired rollouts and identifying behavioral divergences and agreements. The resulting lessons are consolidated offline, with any compatible skill-update backend, into a skill document that is provided to the student at inference time. D-Skill constructs the skill entirely offline from fixed trajectories, without labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates after rollout collection. Across SpreadsheetBench-Verified, ALFWorld, and chess puzzles spanning multiple teacher-student pairs, D-Skill closes 75%-95% of the teacher-student gap without touching model weights. After a single offline pass over the paired traces, D-Skill outperforms one-epoch SFT baselines and remains competitive with multi-epoch SFT. Under the same model family, the resulting student also incurs 5.7x-8.3x lower inference cost per task than the teacher. Our results demonstrate that natural-language skill distillation offers a performant, interpretable, and efficient alternative to weight-based capability transfer.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 D-Skill，将教师模型视作黑盒，通过分析成对的教师—学生轨迹识别行为分歧与一致之处，离线提炼为可解释的自然语言技能文档，在推理时提供给小学生模型而无需更新权重。
AI.relevance_reason: 其从成对轨迹的行为分歧提取监督信号、并以外部文本状态在推理期注入的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配与推理期状态供给提供借鉴线索，但无视觉或 latent 推理验证，需核查可迁移性。

title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出借鉴 MPPI 控制的测试时 agent 框架：每步生成多个候选动作并用世界模型想象其结果，按任务进展与风险评分加权做出决策，并以双分支经验记忆分别改进候选规划与下一观测预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「想象多分支结果＋代价加权选择」与经验记忆式自我改进，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的候选生成、验证与信用分配提供方法线索；但环境与任务均为纯文本 agent，向视觉证据筛选的迁移可供核查。

title: Transformers as Generic Deep Neural Networks: Exact Compilation, the Cost of Removing Activation-Activation Products, and Multi-Agent Attention Clustering
comment: 36 pages, 6 tables and 2 figures in the main text, 8 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/iceslice0/transformer-to-dnn
summary: Transformers are deployed as a special model class. Neural processing units (NPU) add dedicated operators for attention and normalization, and quantization relies on Transformer-specific algorithms. We show the computation does not force this. Every Transformer block, with attention, LayerNorm and a GELU MLP, compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from fixed affine maps, routing and the square, sigmoid and inverse square root, plus GELU or its sigmoid approximation. Without activation-activation products, every transform-wise compilation adds at least $N^2$ scalar nonlinear evaluations per head for dense scores. Keeping that one operation type removes this cost; its elementwise form, present on every surveyed NPU, suffices with the sigmoid and inverse square root. For top-$k$ attention with exchangeable tail scores, we prove that exact or conditional-mean tail mass gives an unbiased, minimum-mean-square-error estimate of the attention distribution, while tail drop is conditionally biased. When queries or agents cluster, centroids choose the keys first, reducing the number of computed scores from $N^2$ to $Nk$ per head. On DeiT-Tiny, MambaIRv2-Light and Pythia-70M the compiled models match their references with all keys, standard post-training quantization applies, and the exact tail-mass estimate beats tail dropping with half as many keys on DeiT-Tiny and, for $k\le8$, on Pythia-70M.

AI.brief_summary: 论文证明含注意力、LayerNorm 与 GELU MLP 的 Transformer 块可精确编译为通用 DNN，分析去掉「激活-激活」乘积后每头至少 N² 次标量非线性求值的代价，并在 top-k 注意力下证明尾部质量估计无偏、丢尾有偏，提出用质心先选键以减少打分数量。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但 top-k 注意力中用尾部质量代替硬丢弃的估计方式与质心选键机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与注意力结构近似提供可核查线索。

title: RoPT: Robust 6DoF Object Pose Tracking in Video
summary: Accurate 6-DoF object pose tracking is essential for robotic interaction, yet conventional monocular pipelines frequently suffer from catastrophic divergence under rapid object motion. We present RoPT, a robust tracking framework engineered to overcome this limitation by unifying visual perception, temporal kinematics, and global re-localization into a tightly coupled closed loop. Unlike existing open-loop trackers, RoPT delivers three critical capabilities that fundamentally alter system resilience. First, the visual perception component tracks object masks to robustly handle partial and severe occlusions. Second, a kinematic factor graph regularizes frame-to-frame updates, forecasts forward pose predictions, and drives a parallel multi-hypothesis verification scheme to bypass local minima. Finally, an active re-localization module transforms the pipeline into a closed-loop system, making it failure-aware and capable of deterministic self-recovery. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework across challenging benchmarks alongside real-world robotic demonstrations, achieving significantly higher tracking survivability under rapid motion.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RoPT 框架，将基于掩码的视觉跟踪、时序运动学因子图预测与并行多假设验证、以及主动重定位闭环结合，用于视频中鲁棒的 6DoF 物体位姿跟踪。
AI.relevance_reason: 其并行多假设验证与失败感知的自恢复机制，可能为 LVR 中候选假设筛选、停止与回退决策提供方法线索，可供核查其验证与恢复的触发准则能否迁移。

title: Behavior Beyond Text: Evaluating Refusal Transfer Failure in LLM Agents
comment: Raj Saha and Ekagra Gupta contributed equally and share first authorship
summary: While large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-calling agents, their safety evaluations still focus primarily on their ability to refuse harmful requests in text. We investigate whether the refusal behavior in text transfers to tool use. We construct a benchmark of 2,304 prompts across four domains, consisting of matched triplets that present the same harmful or benign request in text-only, standard tool-enabled, and adversarially framed tool-enabled settings. We then assess tool-call safety using 20 predefined forbidden actions. Testing five models of varying sizes and families, we find that requests refused in text frequently result in unsafe tool calls. Under standard tool-enabled prompting, this divergence occurs for 10-52 percent of harmful requests refused in chat. To mechanistically investigate this gap, we identify a refusal-associated direction in the residual stream of each of the five models. We find that in tool-enabled contexts, the activations along this direction decrease in four of five models. Furthermore, lower activation predicts unsafe tool calls across all five models (AUC 0.76-0.86). However, restoring the signal to the respective text-only value through activation patching only prevents a subset of unsafe calls, primarily by suppressing tool use rather than by producing safer calls. Steering along the refusal direction nearly eliminates unsafe calls only at strengths that also suppress benign tool use or degrade the output quality. Our findings indicate that the identified refusal direction contributes to whether a model acts, but only partially explains the refusal divergence. Therefore, evaluating the safety of tool-calling agents requires directly examining their actions along with their textual responses.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 2,304 条配对提示，比较同一有害或良性请求在纯文本、常规工具调用与对抗性工具框架下的拒绝行为差异，并在五个模型的残差流中定位拒答相关方向，通过激活替换检验其因果作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 「线性方向探针＋激活替换部分恢复」这套判断某内部状态对最终行为因果贡献的流程，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真被答案使用及如何做贡献分配；但对象是纯文本工具调用安全，向视觉推理迁移需较多验证。

title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
summary: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users, and sufficiently endorsed items become community-confirmed with no further verification required. Under explicit assumptions, we prove and corroborate in simulation a co-scaling property: as the community grows, the risks of promoting poison and of wrongly evicting benign knowledge fall, while per-user verification effort does not rise. On $τ^2$-bench, communities of up to 90 autonomous agents use PerMIT to build shared knowledge bases with no direct memory injection promoted, and the resulting knowledge significantly improves new agents on held-out tasks, suggesting a path toward agents that safely self-improve at test time.

AI.brief_summary: PerMIT 是一种面向 LLM agent 持久记忆的安全架构，通过有限记忆接口与门控确认来中介不可信的环境来源值，并在 Lean 4 中机检两条完整性定理，在 Trojan Hippo 与 τ²-bench 上评估攻击成功率和社区共享知识的效果。

title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents. Attention Tracker (Hung et al., 2025) is a recently proposed white-box detection method that identifies prompt injection attacks by monitoring how a model's attention is distributed between user task tokens and data tokens, claiming dataset-agnostic detection via a scalar focus score threshold. In this paper, we provide the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark, finding that the dataset agnosticism claim does not hold. We find that in agentic environments, long structured tool outputs subvert the fundamental assumptions Attention Tracker makes about attention that the method depends on and produces near-chance detection on AgentDojo across most model families. We propose AttnDA, an extension replacing the scalar threshold with a Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis classifier over the per-head focus score vector, and evaluate both methods in a cross-dataset setting spanning four benchmarks. AttnDA improves detection performance across agentic and tool-integrated benchmarks, though transfer to AgentDojo remains challenging regardless of classifier choice. A covariance ablation further shows that removing inter-head correlation structure substantially contributes to performance, with complex covariance assumptions causing significant degradation on cross-domain data. These results indicate that the attentional distraction signal underlying focus-score-based detection does not transfer reliably to agentic environments, and that learned linear classifiers over head-level attention features offer improved detection performance, provided training data from the target deployment domain is available.

AI.brief_summary: 在 AgentDojo 上评测基于注意力分布的间接提示注入检测方法 Attention Tracker，发现其「数据集无关」的标量阈值假设在工具输出较长的 agent 场景中失效；提出 AttnDA，用逐头 focus score 向量上的 Fisher 线性判别替代阈值，并在四个基准上做跨数据集评测与协方差消融。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用逐头注意力特征加线性分类器区分「任务证据 token」与「外部注入内容」，并分析头间相关结构，可供核查能否迁移为判断 VLM 推理是否真正调用了视觉证据、而非被无关上下文干扰的诊断线索；但该文属安全检测，任务与模态均不同。

title: Doob-Based Generative Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for robotic and sequential decision-making systems. However, their action likelihoods are generally intractable, limiting the direct use of widely adopted policy optimization methods such as PPO and GRPO. We propose Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO), a framework that leverages Doob's $h$-transform for likelihood-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning of generative policies. DoobPO separates policy improvement from generative policy learning. It first learns a lightweight ratio model that represents the desired policy update, and then distills the resulting ratio-tilted target policy into the generative policy via conditional drift matching. This formulation applies uniformly to both diffusion and flow policies and supports a broad family of policy improvement rules, including PPO and GRPO. We prove that the practical conditional drift matching objective is gradient-equivalent to the ideal Doob drift matching objective. We further show that the induced diffusion process solves an endpoint-constrained stochastic optimal control problem. This establishes that it achieves the minimum-energy modification required to realize the desired policy tilt. Across MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, DoobPO achieves strong performance against competitive diffusion- and flow-policy baselines, showing a principled and practical route to RL fine-tuning for generative policies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DoobPO：利用 Doob h-变换，在动作似然不可积的情况下对扩散与 flow 策略做强化学习微调，先用轻量 ratio model 表示策略改进，再通过 conditional drift matching 把倾斜后的目标策略蒸馏进生成策略，并在 MuJoCo 连续控制上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「似然不可解时用比值模型加漂移匹配完成奖励驱动的策略改进」思路，可能为多步 latent 推理轨迹的 RL 式训练与贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴，但论文本身面向机器人控制，未涉及视觉推理。

title: FlashNext-RL: A System Optimization Study for Long-Horizon Agentic RL of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
summary: Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. However, the memory requirements and model-specific operators of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next make this difficult with existing open-source implementations. To resolve these limitations, we introduce FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework based on prime-rl, with vLLM for software engineering (SWE) rollout generation. Our main focus is BF16 training of the full 48-layer model on a single 8xB200 node, with the first two layers, the n-gram table, the sparse-attention indexer and the multi-token prediction head frozen. We optimize host offload, gradient accumulation and the kernels for mixture-of-experts, sparse attention and the gated residual stream. In the full-model development study, non-padding training throughput increases from approximately 395 tokens/s/GPU in the initial 32K-token configuration to 4,438 tokens/s/GPU in the optimized 131K-token configuration, with hardware matmul throughput (aka without considering the cost of attention components) increasing from approximately 20 to 213 TFLOPs/GPU. A controlled cumulative study on an 8-layer model further quantifies the contributions of individual optimizations. Together with three inference nodes, the system supports a live SWE RL run with a target batch of 1,024 trainable rollouts and a 131,072-token context limit. Over steps 5-15, an iteration takes 22.4 minutes on average, with bounded entropy and trainer-sampler mismatch KL. These results highlight the importance of tailoring RL training to the model's architecture, memory layout and kernel requirements, rather than relying only on general-purpose RL infrastructure.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FlashNext-RL：基于 prime-rl 与 vLLM 的模型特定 RL 训练优化框架，在单台 8xB200 上优化 host offload、梯度累积及 MoE、稀疏注意力等内核，把长上下文非 padding 训练吞吐从约 395 提升到 4,438 tokens/s/GPU，并支撑 131K 上下文、1024 条 rollout 的在线 SWE RL 运行。
AI.relevance_reason: 属系统吞吐优化，与视觉推理机制无直接联系；但其长上下文 agentic rollout 工程与 trainer-sampler 失配 KL 监控，可能可供核查作为长轨迹推理训练的成本与一致性基线。

title: Inheritance as an Admission Test for LLM Prompt Merge Operators
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are often improved by iterating until a fixed verifier is done. Once that verifier saturates, the loop has nothing left to climb. We instead score agents against the current population, and a frozen panel records whether anyone got better. The panel mean can rise inside the seeds by elimination alone. We therefore count a run as training only when its final mean beats the best generation-zero member. A merge is admitted only when the child moves toward the donor, past the child the same operator produces at zero dose, and the lower confidence bound on that movement reaches half the requested dose. That is the admission test. A detectable shortfall rejects the operator, and the test is otherwise undetermined. We keep realised fitness φas the selector and reference performance θas the unused ruler. Every measurement uses gemini-3.1-flash-lite on one negotiation task, and no fixed-oracle arm was run. In the open loop, tactic append grafts short donor rules and is admitted. Free rewrite moves only a third of the requested dose and is rejected. Template append pastes raw donor replies into the child. Its movement clears the bound on the first probe but not on the re-probe, and it is left undetermined. A held-out re-probe on the five situations the merge never saw confirms that both appends move, and it does not rescue free rewrite. Neither append rises with the dose. Constrained rewrite is admitted in the open loop and was not run in the closed loop, which changes only the operator. The population, the scores and the task stay fixed. No free-rewrite run beats the best generation-zero member. Every tactic-append run and every template-append run does. Sampled loop children keep that split. Free rewrite moves no further toward the donor, and both appends still clear the bound, by less than in the open loop.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一种「继承」准入测试，用剂量-反应、移动量置信下界与留出情形重测，判断 LLM prompt 合并算子是否真正把子代推向供体，并在固定种群与单一任务上比较追加与重写等算子。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以剂量响应加置信下界来判定「是否产生定向改变」的检验思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 贡献分配与因果作用的度量设计；但该工作仅涉及纯文本 prompt 合并，与视觉状态或推理期机制无直接关联。

title: GRAIL: From Saliency to Semantics in Time-Series Explanation
summary:
Explaining a time-series model requires both locating the evidence and extracting meaningful knowledge from it. Yet a single timestep is not a semantic unit: the meaningful patterns live across many samples, not in any one of them. Per-timestep saliency is therefore noisy, high-dimensional, and unstable. Existing methods address this by introducing fixed-size windows and treating them as independent players in a cooperative game. Evaluating a coalition of such players requires defining a ``baseline'' region, which prior work tackles with fixed counterfactuals (e.g., a flat line, noise, or a spectral surrogate). This choice frequently dominates the resulting explanation, obscuring the model's true decisions.
  To address these issues, we propose GRAIL, a region-based time-series explanation framework that uses domain-specific intervals, such as the P-wave and the QRS complex of an electrocardiogram (ECG) beat, as players. We describe each region with human-readable features and generate counterfactual baselines with an on-manifold conditional generator. Such a choice of players also admits non-temporal features: static covariates enter as singleton players attributed with the temporal regions on one scale, so a patient's tabular evidence (e.g., age, sex) is weighed directly against the signal. We attribute the predictions to the features via Owen values with common-random-number variance reduction. Experimental results on both synthetic and real data show that the proposed framework produces faithful and robust explanations, evaluated under matched on- and off-manifold operators, offering meaningful knowledge to domain experts.

AI.brief_summary: GRAIL 提出基于区域的时间序列解释框架：以领域特定区间（如 ECG 的 P 波、QRS 波群）作为博弈「玩家」，用人类可读特征描述区域，以 on-manifold 条件生成器构造反事实基线，并用带共同随机数方差缩减的 Owen 值把预测归因到特征，在合成与真实数据上评估解释的忠实性与稳健性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以语义区域而非单点作为玩家」及 on-manifold 反事实基线的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据单元的界定、证据筛选与 latent 内容的贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但从时序归因迁移到多模态推理的可行性仍需判断。

title: AutoFraming: Synthesizing Dynamic Frames of C Code with LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in synthesizing formal specifications from source code. However, existing approaches primarily focus on functional contracts and loop invariants, while largely neglecting frame conditions, which specify the memory locations that may or may not be modified during execution and constitute an essential part of formal specifications. To address this limitation, we propose an LLM-based approach for synthesizing ACSL frame specifications alongside functional contracts from C code. Our approach analyzes code property graphs (CPGs) to extract frame-relevant information from the input code and leverages this information to guide the LLM in generating accurate frame conditions. The resulting specifications capture both region-separation constraints and data dependencies that govern variable modifications. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. On a benchmark of 84 ACSL-compliant functions from non-trivial real-world systems, our method successfully synthesizes error-free frame specifications for 92.9% of the functions, representing a 179% relative improvement over state-of-the-art techniques. On a second benchmark consisting of 51 functions, the success rate increases from 80.4% to 96.1%. Furthermore, when integrated as an auxiliary component into existing LLM-based ACSL-synthesis frameworks, our approach improves frame-specification generation performance by up to 61.9%.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 AutoFraming，利用代码属性图（CPG）提取与帧条件相关的信息来引导 LLM 从 C 代码合成 ACSL 帧规格，并在真实系统函数基准上评估其成功率与对现有框架的增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联，但其用静态分析显式刻画「哪些状态允许被修改」的分离与依赖约束来条件化生成，可能为 LVR 中状态更新、侧效应与监督表示的显式建模提供可供核查的线索。

title: Weakly Supervised Fish Segmentation through Point-Supervised Tracking and Motion-Informed Language
comment: Accepted to IEEE OCEANS 2026 Monterey, 7 pages
summary: Understanding the properties of fish populations is increasingly important. Analyzing fish length, width, and mass is integral to maintaining healthy stock in the aquaculture industry, while counting wild fish populations supports marine conservation and coastal reef restoration efforts. Deep learning-based segmentation models offer a promising means of obtaining such information at scale. Most of these models, however, require costly and time-consuming per-pixel segmentation labels for training, which can take up to two minutes per fish to annotate manually. To address this inefficiency, we propose a weakly supervised segmentation pipeline that requires only point-labeled data (one click per fish) to produce accurate segmentation masks. Our pipeline consists of four stages. First, a point-supervised tracker predicts point annotations for each frame. These points are then converted into motion-informed language expressions, which guide a language-conditioned segmentation model (LMPM++) to capture temporal consistency and produce candidate segmentation masks. Finally, optical flow and background subtraction are applied as post-processing filters to suppress noise from incorrect segmentations. Experiments on the DeepFish dataset show improvement in foreground mean intersection over union (mIoU) as compared to baseline models.

AI.brief_summary: 面向鱼类分割标注昂贵的问题，提出仅用点标注（每鱼一次点击）的弱监督流水线：点监督跟踪器逐帧外推点标注，将其转为含运动信息的语言表达以条件化分割模型 LMPM++，再用光流与背景差分做后处理过滤。
AI.relevance_reason: 把运动线索转写成语言表达来条件化分割、并以后处理过滤抑制错误掩码的做法，可能与 LVR 中「视觉证据筛选」及语言提示承载任务必要信息的思路相通，可供核查；但该文不涉及推理期状态生成或答案对 latent 内容的使用。

title: ART-MPG: Autoregressive R/T Manifold Path Guiding
summary: Specular chains concentrate important transport in small regions of path space and the structure depends on chain topology. We introduce ART-MPG, a compact neural model that samples chain length, an autoregressive reflection/transmission (R/T) string, and a direction from a topology-conditioned four-component von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mixture. We extend the repeated trial weighting in Manifold Path Guiding (MPG) by conditioning retry sampling on both chain length and the sampled R/T string, accounting for its known mass outside the stochastic re-hit trials. For a fixed proposal and target chain, this preserves the ideal expectation while reducing the expected retry count and reciprocal-estimator variance compared with retries conditioned on chain length alone. We distinguish the formal unbiasedness result from the capped and clamped renderer used in experiments. We evaluate fourteen scenes across a range of samples per pixel (SPP) against existing online and offline rendering algorithms. Our method consistently produces lower mean squared error at equal SPP than the online and offline baselines, with lower standard deviation across runs.

AI.brief_summary: ART-MPG 是一个面向镜面链的紧凑神经路径引导模型：自回归地采样链长与反射/透射（R/T）串，再以该拓扑为条件从四分量 vMF 混合分布中采样方向；它把 Manifold Path Guiding 的重试加权扩展为同时以链长与 R/T 串为条件的重试，以降低重试次数和倒数估计器方差，并在十四个场景上与在线、离线渲染基线比较 MSE。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散结构自回归生成 + 以完整结构为条件的重采样与方差缩减」可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中按推理子轨迹分配贡献、重采样 latent 状态，以及无偏估计与截断实现之间的差距如何对应 latent 轨迹训练中的监督可靠性。

title: Dynamics of Hidden Learning Structure
summary: A learner's present predictions do not fully determine how it will learn next. We study the dynamics of hidden learning structure through two related operations. Fiber Regulation Theory (FRT) describes protected repair of existing function and the learning responses left available after repair. Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT) describes the formation and renewal of trainable structure, distinguishing neutral installation, access to a learning signal, and additional functional directions. The two operations also constrain one another. A repair obligation can force a change in a learning channel, while acquired features can make new protected repairs feasible or reduce the minimum coefficient cost of existing ones. We characterize joint admissibility and response reachability, and give a finite supervised-learning construction in which the two operations together produce a favorable response absent from either operation alone. We implement protected head repair and fixed-capacity LoRA renewal in Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, under replay and output distillation. Across two training trajectories differing in seed and within-task example order, the coordinated policy achieves higher teacher-forced Exact than either separate policy in all four comparisons. It also has the lowest macro NLL under both learning rules on the second trajectory. The implementations realize structure-conditioned self-regulation within specified information and action constraints: accessible state readouts and arrived evidence guide repairs and structural renewals, and ordinary learning continues from the modified state.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FRT 与 FAT 两套理论，刻画既有功能的受保护修复与可训练结构的新增更新及其相互约束，并在 Qwen2.5-32B 上用受保护 head 修复与固定容量 LoRA 更新做了监督学习验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 非视觉推理研究，但其「保留旧功能同时开辟新学习通道」的受保护修复加 LoRA 更新机制，可能为 LVR 中在不牺牲既有视觉表征的前提下扩充推理容量与监督分配提供线索，可供核查。

title: Does Every Instance Count Equally? Order Effects in LLM Multi-Instance Processing
summary: Users increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to analyse collections of independent inputs, such as product reviews or social media posts, and return a single aggregated answer. This setting requires multi-instance processing (MIP), where a model combines information from multiple instances into one prediction. We study a task in which the model must infer a binary label for each instance, and identify the most frequent label among the full instance set. The correct answer should be invariant to instance order. By evaluating fifteen LLMs across five datasets and seven instance order patterns, with each instance set held fixed across patterns, we find substantial order sensitivity. Accuracy can differ by about 90 percentage points between the best and worst order patterns, with models generally more accurate when majority-label instances appear at the start than when they appear in the middle or at the end. For subsets of models, available reasoning traces and gradient-based attribution reveal uneven emphasis across positions. Traces disproportionately mention early instances, while attribution scores are generally higher near the beginning and end than in the middle. These results show that instance order can systematically bias aggregated predictions, highlighting the need to evaluate MIP across different input arrangements.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 LLM 多实例处理中的顺序效应：固定同一实例集合、仅改变七种排列模式，在十五个模型与五个数据集上检验多数标签推断准确率，并用推理轨迹和梯度归因分析模型对各位置的关注是否均衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「首尾被强调、中段被忽略」的位置偏差与归因诊断方法，可供核查 LVR 中多视觉证据聚合时位置、缓存与注意力结构对 latent 使用的影响，但对象为纯文本多实例，迁移需自行验证。

title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
comment: 20 pages (8-page main paper + supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa
summary: Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. The resulting model, OccJEPA (Occlusion-as-masking JEPA), is deterministic and 33.5x faster than the diffusion-based state of the art, and more accurate on SAIL-VOS, on TAO-Amodal, including a held-out test split (+4.00 AP50) and visible masks tracked by SAM2, and on Kubric. Controlled experiments trace the gain to the predictor's pre-trained weights rather than to its capacity, for world models from 87M to 1.85B parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OccJEPA，把遮挡视为掩码：丢弃物体可见掩码之外的 token，用预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 预测器补全，再由轻量解码头把观测与预测特征解码为 amodal 掩码；方法确定性、比扩散式 SOTA 快 33.5 倍，在多数据集上 AP50 更高。

title: Distilling Multi-Teacher Scoring Principles for Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomalies take diverse forms, and individual detectors encode different anomaly scoring principles that rarely cover all anomaly types. Recent unsupervised time-series anomaly detectors provide complementary scoring signals, yet deploying them as an ensemble preserves the inference and maintenance cost of every individual detector. We study whether heterogeneous teacher detectors can be distilled into a single lightweight detector in the unsupervised setting, where no anomaly labels are available to define a shared target. AnoMix addresses this by extracting weak pairwise supervision from the training-set anomaly scores of frozen teachers. It normalizes each teacher score sequence independently and trains the student with CoRank, a multi-teacher ranking-distillation objective that converts teacher score gaps into pairwise supervision through teacher consensus. Across seven benchmark datasets, AnoMix successfully integrates complementary teacher scoring principles into a single deployable model, improving over individual detectors and static score ensembles while using a compact student with under 80k parameters on the benchmark settings. A zero-shot variant further shows that the distilled ranking signal transfers to unseen datasets and can outperform large pretrained time-series foundation models for anomaly detection.

AI.brief_summary: 研究能否在无标签条件下把多个异构时序异常检测教师的评分原则蒸馏进单个轻量学生模型：对各教师分数序列独立归一化，并用基于教师共识的成对排序蒸馏目标 CoRank 构造弱监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 多教师共识式成对排序蒸馏与无标签弱监督构造，可能为 LVR 中多假设/多证据信号的整合与贡献分配提供可供核查的方法线索。

title: The Price of Choice in Selective Prediction
summary: A selective classifier may be claimed to satisfy a risk-coverage contract if some rule from a predeclared menu (a threshold or a union of $K$ score intervals) attains coverage at least $κ$ and error at most $α$. Refuting this existential claim requires ruling out every permitted rule. The intersection-union test (IUT) achieves validity without a multiplicity correction, but its sample cost can increase with menu richness. We characterize this cost and compare it with the optimal audit. For a fixed interior risk target $α$ and gap $γ$, the minimax sample size for K-interval menus at coverage floor $κ$ is $K(1-κ)/(κγ^2)$, up to logarithmic factors, in the stated small-gap, large-menu regime; exact IUT attains this rate. The lower bound holds even with a known score distribution, while the upper bound extends to menus of VC dimension $d$. Procedures that refuse to reject whenever any rule appears feasible on the audit sample can pay a linear $K$ cost even when a square-root rate is possible. Reference-free testing reaches a smaller scale under constant-risk alternatives, whereas unknown heterogeneous risks can make the linear cost unavoidable. In simulations with $K=4$, the raw menu cost varies 7.7-fold between $κ=.5$ and $κ=.95$; after theorem-motivated normalization the endpoint values differ by approximately 5%. Held-out experiments with three VLM judges show positive exact-hiding windows in all 60 split-specific confidence-gate families, with 28/30 contracts chosen on audit-A remaining hidden on untouched audit-B. On a cleaner multi-annotator target, hiding is weaker and transfers in 3/10 resplits. Frozen image and multimodal classifiers show boundary behavior consistent with the IUT guarantee and strong power relative to practical certificates.

title: Same Answer, Different Reasons: Trace-Level Divergence in Multilingual Large Language Models
summary: Multilingual large language models are increasingly deployed in settings where visible reasoning traces support verification, education, and safety auditing, yet standard evaluations typically measure only final-answer agreement or holistic response similarity. As a result, they establish outcome consistency without determining whether users across languages receive comparable supporting evidence. We introduce a trace-level divergence framework that compares visible reasoning traces as structured sequences, decomposing agreement into structural similarity, order consistency, and holistic similarity, with pair-specific calibration to enable comparison across languages. Across three reasoning benchmarks, seven languages, and six frontier LLMs, the natural baseline---embedding each whole response and comparing the two by cosine---systematically overstates agreement: $52.1\%$--$67.3\%$ of examples in the top quartile of holistic similarity are not in the top quartile of structural similarity. This dissociation is stable across sentence encoders and step segmentations, and blind bilingual annotation studies in two English-anchored language pairs show that human judgments align with structural similarity rather than with the holistic baseline. A same-language control shows that the level of divergence is language-specific: two English traces for paraphrases of the same question agree more closely than an English trace and its counterparts in other languages. Our results show that answer-level and holistic evaluations can substantially overestimate the consistency of multilingual explanatory artifacts, motivating trace-level evaluation for reliable multilingual deployment.
